# Lamentations 4 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 4:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | The-tongue-of the-nursing-child cleaves to-his-palate from-thirst; young-children ask-for bread — no-one breaks-[it] for-them. |
| LOGOS | The tongue of the nursing infant sticks to the roof of its mouth for thirst; the children beg for food, but no one gives to them. |
| PNEUMA | Babies' tongues stick to the roofs of their mouths from thirst. Little children cry for bread, and no one has any to give them. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning.

## 4:5 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Those-who-ate delicacies are-desolate in-the-streets; those-raised on-crimson embrace ash-heaps. |
| LOGOS | Those who once feasted on delicacies perish in the streets; those who were brought up in purple embrace ash heaps. |
| PNEUMA | People who once ate the finest foods are dying in the streets. Those raised wearing the finest clothes now dig through garbage piles. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning.

| EMET | And-the-iniquity-of the-daughter-of my-people was-greater than-the-sin-of Sodom, which-was-overthrown as-in-a-moment — and-no hands were-wrung over-her. |
| LOGOS | For the chastisement of the daughter of my people has been greater than the punishment of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment, and no hands were wrung for her. |
| PNEUMA | The punishment of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was destroyed in an instant — at least no one had to watch her suffer. |

## 4:22 (overlap: 4%)

| EMET | Your-iniquity is-completed, daughter-of Zion — He-will-not-again exile-you; He-will-punish your-iniquity, daughter-of Edom — He-will-uncover your-sins. |
| LOGOS | The punishment of your iniquity, O daughter of Zion, is accomplished; He will keep you in exile no longer; but your iniquity, O daughter of Edom, He will punish; He will uncover your sins. |
| PNEUMA | Your punishment is complete, O Jerusalem — He won't send you into exile again. But as for you, Edom — He is about to punish you. He will expose all your sins. |

| PNEUMA | The precious people of Zion — once worth their weight in gold — are now treated like cheap clay pots made by any ordinary potter. |

| PNEUMA | Go ahead and celebrate while you can, people of Edom, living in the land of Uz. But your turn is coming — you'll drink from this cup of judgment too, until you're stumbling drunk and stripped bare. |
